prompt: Create a vertical manga-style science fiction illustration of two young girls driving a small boxy orange-yellow open-top utility car through a dusty orange desert filled with radio telescope dishes. In the foreground, the driver is a serious anime girl with dark navy-black hair in a long side braid, large expressive eyes, and a white lab-coat-like robe with a small chest badge reading “5”; her hands grip the steering wheel. Beside her sits a pale, soft-featured girl with white-blonde messy short hair tied into a tiny low ponytail, looking to the right, wearing a matching white robe with a badge reading “4.8” and holding a small beige stuffed rabbit with blue button-like eyes. The vehicle has two visible round headlights, a red front grille, simple red trim on the side, black tires, and kicks up a winding trail of pale dust behind it along a curving dirt road. The background contains exactly 11 visible satellite dishes: one enormous vine-covered parabolic dish dominating the left side, three medium-to-large dishes across the midground, five small distant dishes scattered near the horizon, and two broken tilted dish panels half-buried in the sand. Above, the turquoise sky contains exactly two pale cream suns, while an inverted futuristic city hangs from the very top edge like a dense upside-down skyline of cream mechanical towers and pipes. Use a retro hand-drawn manga aesthetic with fine ink linework, muted teal and ochre color palette, lightly aged paper grain, delicate hatching, high detail, whimsical post-apocalyptic mood, cinematic vertical composition, no speech bubbles, no watermark, and only the two badge texts “5” and “4.8” visible.
